metadata.value: For [SemREC'22](https://semrec.github.io) at the [International Semantic Web Conference 2022 (ISWC'22)](https://iswc2022.semanticweb.org) we provide [CaLiGraph](http://caligraph.org) as an additional challenge dataset for the participants of Task 2 (Systems). For this purpose, we use the subsets `clg_10e4`, `clg_10e5`, and `clg_full` and split their inferrable assertions into training, validation, and test files. These files are used to train and evaluate neuro-symbolic reasoners.
